title: Matt Le Tissier appointed by Southampton in formal advisory role
content:
Matt Le Tissier has returned to Southampton in an advisory role which will support the club’s board.

Le Tissier is expected to work with the club’s football department and contribute to decision-making.

The 57-year-old, one of Southampton’s most celebrated players, previously stepped down from his role as club ambassador in 2022 following criticism of his social media activity.

Le Tissier’s activity included posts on the covid-19 pandemic and the disease’s vaccine, sharing claims that “the media” had lied about “weapons of mass destruction and COVID”, as well as quoting a post that appeared to call into question the legitimacy of media coverage on Bucha, a Ukrainian city that was the site of a ground troops battle between invading Russian and Ukrainian forces.

Le Tisser made 540 appearances for Southampton between 1986 and 2002, scoring 209 goals. Before going on to play for non-League sides Eastleigh and Guernsey.

Southampton are seventh in the Championship and unbeaten in all competitions since January 17, a run of 14 games. They host Premier League leaders Arsenal in the quarter-finals of the FA Cup on Saturday.
